target_customer: Software engineering teams that want to run many coding agents in parallel
problem: Coding agents run one at a time and need supervision. Capy orchestrates swarms of agents on cloud VMs from one dashboard. The company began as Scrapybara, virtual desktops for AI agents.
business_model: Subscription tiers Free, Lite 20 USD, Pro 100 USD, Max 200 USD per month plus Enterprise; earlier usage based infrastructure API for Scrapybara

founders.name: Justin Sun
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; the two met at MultiOn and built the Retrieve web extraction API.

technical_complexity.rationale: Fast booting secure VMs for agents (sub second starts reported) and orchestration of long lived agents is infrastructure heavy for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and workflows add some lock in, but model vendors and coding tools ship similar parallel agent features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Computer use and coding agent products from model vendors overlapped both Scrapybara and Capy; exact dates not verified.

market_need_then: In late 2024 computer use agents were new (Anthropic launched computer use in October 2024) and developers needed sandboxes to run them; I did not open a dated source for this.

branding.name_origin: Company docs show a capybara theme dating from Scrapybara (a scrape plus capybara pun is plausible but not stated); Capy shortens it. Reason not sourced.

identity.mascot_or_character: Capybara in costumes such as Captain Capy and Detective Capy
identity.voice_and_tone: Playful marketing with formal security messaging

rebrands.why: Not stated; directory says Capy launched February 2026 as an IDE after pivoting from virtual desktops (unverified)

branding.community_and_virality: No community or press about the brand found beyond directory listings.

brand_strength.rationale: Mascot and distinctive name are memorable, and the shorter Capy name is easier than Scrapybara; there is no evidence of brand driven growth yet.

pivots.from: Scrapybara, virtual desktops for AI agents via API
pivots.to: Capy, parallel coding agent IDE and swarm platform
pivots.why: Not stated; date from an unverified directory listing

outcome_analysis: Capy began as Scrapybara, infrastructure for computer use agents, and moved toward a coding agent orchestration product with paid tiers and enterprise features by 2026. It is still active, but no funding beyond YC is verified and model vendors compete directly, so the result of the pivot is not yet clear.
notes: Funding seen only on aggregators (VCBacked, FundedIQ, StartupHub say 500K pre-seed around 2024-12; Simplify says 130K), conflicting and unverified, not recorded. No competitor source dated near the batch was found that I could cite beyond a directory; list is empty. The pivot date is from an unverified directory. Legal entity is Scrapybara, Inc.
